summary: Created MPI-657: the 30-minute install-queue ceiling is a fixed constant and fired on a healthy 24.55GB download. Spun out of MPI-653.

todo -> doing. Brief corrected first: the ceiling fired on model minimax-h3-ref2va (not the dep h3-qwen3vl-32b-clip), and it deleted nothing - the partial went to a user cancel 52min later. Fix retargeted from bytes-derived to an idle ceiling.

doing -> done. The 30min ceiling is now IDLE time: arm() clears and re-sets the timer, every matching download:progress tick re-arms it. Not bytes-derived - that only relocates the guess into an assumed rate. 5/5 in install-queue-wedge, 20/20 across install-*/download-*, and both mutations (drop the re-arm, drop the clearTimeout) fail the suite.

Claim audit at close-out caught two wrong numbers, both corrected on the card: the cancel was rejected by SIX entries (five weight deps + ComfyUI-MpiNodes), not five; and the stall watchdog threshold is STALL_MS 60s swept every 15s (~75s worst case), not "caught in 15s". Neither changes the fix. The commit body b15c179e still carries both and cannot be amended on a shared master, so validation.md records them.
